signIn.title: Sign in to host an event
signIn.body: Pick a spot, set a time, and invite your neighbors. You will be the organizer.

followersNote: Your followers get notified when you publish.

basics.title: What's happening?
basics.help: Name it and pick the kind of event.
basics.error: Add a title for your event.

when.title: When is it?
when.help: Pick a day, a start time and how long it runs.
when.error: Pick a date and start time in the future.
when.error_end: Pick an end time after the start.

where.title: Where do you meet?
where.help: Drop the pin where neighbors should show up.
where.error: Set the meeting point on the map.

details.title: Who do you need?
details.help: Add at least one sign-up slot. People join your event by signing up for one.
details.error: Name at least one sign-up slot.
details.error_invalid: Give every slot a name and a valid capacity.

review.title: Ready to publish?
review.error: Add a title, a meeting point, a date, and a time to publish.

error.validation: Please double-check the event details and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.session: Your session may have expired. Sign in again and retry.
error.generic: We could not publish right now. Please try again.
